column2: Retain Josiah's accession at eight, thirty-one years in Jerusalem and Jedida daughter of Edeia from Basouroth. The selected maternal names and place are not replaced by familiar parallel forms.
Retain right conduct, David's entire way and no turning right or left. The directional image remains rather than becoming an abstract obedience claim.
Retain the eighteenth year and explicit eighth month, Sapphan's two-generation lineage and the scribe of the Lord's house. The selected month and office attachment are not omitted.

Retain Chelkias as high priest, sealing the silver, the Lord's house and doorpost guards collecting from the people. Seal is not silently changed to count, and doorpost remains the selected architectural term.
column3: What monetary procedure does sealing signify in this context?

column2: Retain plural let them give followed by singular he gave, workers appointed in the house and strengthening its bedek. The shift from command to narration is preserved by closing the quotation; the singular giver is not named.
column3: Who is the singular giver, and what building defect or repair work does bedek denote here?

column2: Retain carpenters, builders and wall builders, acquisition of timber and quarried stones, and repeated strengthening of bedek. The occupational distinctions and repeated repair purpose remain.
Retain the lack of demanded accounting and the causal faithful work. The selected present act faithfully remains alongside the past accounting statement.
Retain the found book of the law, Chelkias handing it to Sapphan and his reading it. A book is introduced without identifying its complete literary extent from later tradition.

Retain bringing it to King Josiah, reporting, melting down the silver and giving it to the appointed workers. It is supplied from the book context; melted down is not replaced by counting or disbursing alone.
Retain Sapphan's report that Chelkias gave a book and his reading before the king. The repeated book report remains distinct from the preceding financial report.
Retain hearing the law book's words and tearing his own garments. The response is to the spoken text, not merely the sight of the document.
Retain all five delegates, their offices and specified fathers. The commission is not reduced to priest and scribe alone.

Retain seeking the Lord for the king, all people and all Judah, the found book, burning anger among us and failure to do everything written against us. Against us follows the selected preposition rather than silently becoming for us.

Retain Olda as prophetess, Sellem's lineage, garment-keeper designation and residence in Jerusalem's masena. The opaque district term remains unapproved; the office's genealogical attachment is not conclusively resolved.
column3: Which member of the lineage is the garment keeper, and what is the precise local sense of masena?

column2: Retain the prophetess's declaration of Israel's God and the instruction to tell the man who sent the envoys to me. The first-person reference sits within nested prophetic speech and should not be silently assigned a new named speaker.

Retain behold, disasters on place and inhabitants and all book words which Judah's king read. The selected attribution of reading to the king remains although Sapphan read aloud in the preceding narrative.
Retain abandonment, incense to other gods, provocation through handmade works and wrath that burns unquenched. The selected future and negation are not softened into a merely possible warning.
Retain the distinct address to Judah's king, his seeking the Lord and the suspended words you heard introduction. The dash carries the syntactic continuation into the next unit.

Replace you did feel shame, did rend and did weep with you felt shame, tore and wept in ordinary address to Josiah. Retain softened heart, the Lord's presence, obliteration and curse, garments, tears and divine hearing. The close draft preserves the inherited finite forms.

Retain Not so, behold, present adding to the fathers, gathering to the grave in peace and not seeing the disasters. The subsequent violent death is not used to rewrite this promise; the envoys' report closes the scene.
Retain the king sending and gathering all elders of both Judah and Jerusalem to himself. The two groups and comprehensive scope remain explicit.

Retain the royal ascent, every man of Judah, Jerusalem's inhabitants, priests, prophets and all people from small to great. All covenant-book words are read in their hearing; prophets is not changed to another office from a parallel account.

Retain standing beside the pillar, covenant before the Lord, following, three categories of commands, whole heart and soul and establishing the written covenant. The people standing in the covenant remains the concluding participation image.

Retain the high priest, second-rank priests and guards, vessels for Baal/grove/heavenly host, burning in Kidron's sademoth and dust taken to Bethel. Rank interprets the second-order expression provisionally, and sademoth remains unresolved.

Retain chomarim appointed by Judah's kings, the several incense locations and Baal, sun, moon, mazouroth and all the host. No confident priestly or zodiac identification is substituted for the two opaque terms.
column3: Which cult personnel and celestial group do chomarim and mazouroth denote here?

column2: Retain removal of the grove, repeated Kidron torrent, burning and dust reduction, and one grave of the sons of the people. No plural graves or specific social class is imported.

Retain the singular house of the kadesim and women weaving chettiin for the grove. The inherited transliterations acknowledge unresolved cult terminology rather than supplying an unsupported sexual or textile identification.
column3: What contextual evidence establishes the persons designated kadesim and the woven object chettiin?

column2: Retain all priests, Gabaa-to-Beersheba extent and the house of the gates beside Joshua the ruler's gate. The man's left remains the selected spatial reference, without an invented entrance direction.
column3: How do the successive house, doorway and gate phrases define the demolished structure?

column2: Retain non-ascent to Jerusalem's altar and the exception of eating unleavened bread among their brothers. Only expresses the selected exception construction and does not deny every other priestly activity outside this context.

Retain Tapheth, the valley of Ennom's son, both son and daughter and the unnegated lead-through-fire infinitive. The apparent mismatch with defiling remains explicit; no not or so that no one is inserted from another witness.
column3: Is the infinitive descriptive of the site's former use rather than the purpose of defiling it? The English for remains provisional pending syntactic review.

column2: Retain solar horses, entrance, treasury, Nathan/king/eunuch sequence, pharourim and a single sun chariot burned. The difficult title construction is not normalized into a familiar personal name.
column3: How should Nathan, king and eunuch attach, and what location does pharourim indicate?

column2: Retain rooftop altars of Ahaz's upper room, Manasseh's altars in two courts, demolition and dust thrown into Kidron. The plural altars here remain distinct from the singular altar wording of chapter 21.

Retain one house facing Jerusalem, the right side of Mount Mosoath, Solomon's construction and Astarte, Chamos and Molchol with their associated peoples. House is not replaced by plural high places, and Mosoath is not silently translated as corruption.
Retain shattered pillars, destroyed groves and human bones filling their sites. The objects and order remain without an added explanation of ritual contamination.

Retain Bethel's altar and high place, Jeroboam son of Nabat, repeated object emphasis, shattered stones, dust and burned grove. The Greek's explicit stones remain rather than being folded into a generic destruction statement.

Retain city tombs, bones burned on the altar, fulfilment of the man of God's word during Jeroboam's festival and Josiah looking toward that prophet's tomb. The longer selected account is retained within this stored unit, not dropped as a duplicate or detached into an invented verse.

Retain the rocky marker question and the city's answer identifying the man from Judah and his proclamation against Bethel's altar. Rocky marker provisionally interprets skopelon in the tomb context rather than claiming a settled monument type.
column3: Does the selected noun denote an outcrop, conspicuous stone or grave marker here?

column2: Retain leave it, prohibition on moving his bones and their preservation with those of the prophet from Samaria. Both sets of bones remain and are not identified as one person.
Retain all high-place houses in Samaria's cities, Israel's kings as builders provoking the Lord and Josiah repeating the Bethel actions. The extended northern scope is not restricted to Bethel alone.

Retain sacrificing all the local high-place priests on the altars, burning human bones and returning to Jerusalem. Sacrificed reflects the selected verb; the action is neither euphemized nor embellished.
Retain the command to all the people and Passover to the Lord our God according to this covenant book. Our preserves the king's inclusion rather than changing it to your.

Retain this Passover not occurring from the judges' days through all the royal periods of Israel and Judah. The historical claim is not expanded into a denial that any Passover of any kind ever occurred.
Retain the restrictive only, eighteenth year, Passover to the Lord and Jerusalem. The exception construction warrants only here, unlike an ornamental addition elsewhere.

Retain charmers, knowing ones, theraphin, idols and all offensive things, together with the aim of establishing the written law. Knowing ones represents a different Greek formation from chapter 21 and remains subject to contextual lexical review.

Retain no comparable king before or after, returning to the Lord, whole heart, soul and strength and all Moses's law. The three personal faculties remain; this comparison is not flattened into the differently worded praise of Hezekiah.
Retain the Lord's unturned great wrath, Judah and Manasseh's repeated provocation. Josiah's preceding praise does not cancel this contrasting declaration in the translation.
Retain Judah's removal like Israel's, rejection of chosen Jerusalem and the house where the name was promised. The nested name quotation remains without explanatory theological qualification.
Retain all Josiah's deeds and the Judah chronicle question. No narrative from the parallel chronicles is appended.

Retain Nechao's movement against Assyria at the Euphrates, Josiah meeting him and Nechao killing him at Mageddo on seeing him. Against remains an inherited interpretation of epi; no alliance reconstruction or later death location replaces the selected narrative.
column3: Does epi here indicate hostile movement against Assyria or movement toward its king? Historical reconstruction alone cannot decide the rendering.

column2: Retain transporting Josiah already dead, burial in his grave in David's city and the people's anointing and enthronement of Joachas. No death during the return journey is introduced.
Retain age twenty-three, three months in Jerusalem and Amital daughter of Jeremiah from Lemna. The short reign and selected maternal forms remain.
Retain evil in the Lord's eyes according to all the fathers' deeds. The evaluation is not changed to a comparison only with the immediately preceding king.
Retain removal at Deblatha in Emath, prevention of Jerusalem rule and one hundred talents each of silver and gold. The selected gold amount is not corrected to one talent from another source.
Retain Pharaoh making Eliakim son of Josiah king, renaming him Joakim and taking Joachas to Egypt where he died. The name change and the two royal subjects remain distinct.

Retain payment, land assessment at Pharaoh's command and the difficult each-man/they-gave/with-the-people construction. With is not changed to from, and the English is retained provisionally rather than presented as a resolved collection procedure.
column3: Who is the plural subject of gave, and how does each according to his assessment relate to with the people of the land?

column2: Retain Joakim's age twenty-five, eleven years in Jerusalem and Jeldaph daughter of Phedeia from Rouma. The end of the Greek chapter was reopened and read after the first web response ended at verse 35.
Retain the concluding evil-in-the-Lord's-eyes evaluation and the comparison with everything the fathers did. No further reign events are brought forward into this closing unit.
